plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's identity. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper sit right on top of your sense of self, confidence, and direction. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: At its most challenging, the same energy can feel like pressure. What starts out exciting can turn into frustration when one person wants to move faster than the other. You may feel like they're pushing you, while they may feel like they're just trying to get things moving. Because there's so much energy between you, even small disagreements can pick up speed before either of you realizes it.
advice: The good news is that this contact does not have to turn into conflict. It works best when you channel it into something shared. Tackle a project, make plans, get out of the house, or work toward a goal together. The more you have to focus on as a team, the less likely you are to end up pushing against each other.
summaryShort: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper sit right on top of your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
